_comment: Single source of truth for what each experiment needs.
tools/check_tiers.py reads this, opens each .phyphox file, and fails if the
hardware a file actually declares does not match what is claimed here. That
stops the docs drifting away from the files, which is the usual way a
'required' must be present or the experiment is useless.
'optional' is declared with ignoreUnavailable=true, so the experiment still
runs without it and simply leaves those readings empty.

tiers.0: Runs on any phone, including a cheap A-series and an iPhone. Accelerometer, magnetometer, microphone, speaker, torch only.
tiers.1: Needs a barometer and/or gyroscope. Most phones, not the cheapest.
tiers.2: Needs a native app - camera frames, NFC, WiFi RTT, or haptics.
tiers.3: Needs extra hardware - a pickup coil, an ESP32, or UWB tags.

not_on_ios.light: phyphox cannot read the ambient light sensor on Apple devices
not_on_ios.bluetooth: phyphox Bluetooth input is Android only

device-check.title: 0. Device Check
device-check.purpose: Reports what this phone actually has, and its real sample rates.

sound-level-meter.title: Sound Level Meter (A/C/Z)
sound-level-meter.purpose: Weighted sound level, Leq, Lmax/Lmin, peak, noise dose.

emi-survey.title: EMI Survey
emi-survey.purpose: Finds live conductors, for routing copper away from power.

busway-load.title: Busway Load Indicator
busway-load.purpose: Relative loading of a busway or feed, without contact.

magnetic-fingerprint.title: Magnetic Landmark
magnetic-fingerprint.purpose: Find an exact spot again using the building's steel as the map.

fan-tacho.title: Fan Tacho and Bearing Check
fan-tacho.purpose: Fan RPM from blade-passing tone, plus bearing crest factor.

vibration-census.title: Vibration Census
vibration-census.purpose: Which machines are actually running, from one floor recording.

strobe-tacho.title: Strobe Tachometer
strobe-tacho.purpose: Fan speed read by eye, as an independent check on the audio method.

dimension-survey.title: Dimension and Level Survey
dimension-survey.purpose: Sonar distances, air temperature from sound speed, floor level.

walk-logger.title: Synchronised Walk Logger
walk-logger.purpose: Everything at once on one clock, with a waypoint button.

wifi-walk.title: WiFi Walk Survey
wifi-walk.purpose: Waypoints to be joined with a separate WiFi survey.

hall-survey.title: Hall Survey
hall-survey.purpose: Barometric trace plus a logged point per location.

tile-tap.title: Floor Tile Tap Test
tile-tap.purpose: Finds loose or unsupported raised-floor tiles by their ring frequency.
